hypotheses.justification: No other binder or the conclusion mentions it. `fieldBar q M'` (Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_FullLevelJacobian.lean) is an abbrev that takes only the naturals `q M'`. `qExpand ℚ q` needs only `NeZero q`, which elaborates without `hq3` (it comes from the instance context, e.g. `[Fact q.Prime]`). The proof never uses `hq3`: every step depends only on `hj₁`, `hj'`, `hO`, `halg`, `hA₁`, the `Fact (j₁ ≠ 0)` instance and general lemmas (`map_jqModC`, `coeff_jqModC_neg_one`, `qExpand_injective`, which needs only `NeZero N`, and `coeffMap_qExpand`). So the same proof works after deleting it.

It is a Prop hypothesis that nothing else in the statement mentions; `fieldBar q M'` takes only the naturals `q` and `M'`. The proof never refers to it: each of the five membership goals is proved by giving an explicit witness to `hO` from the j-expansion identities, which hold for any `q` and `M'`. So the same proof works after deleting it.

It is an explicit Prop binder, not an instance, so no other part of the statement can depend on it through instance search, and nothing mentions it by name. The proof never uses it. The only fact about `K₁`/`A₁` the proof needs is `hA₁`, which turns `a ∈ A₁` into `(a : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ∈ A` and gives the constant Laurent series witness `HahnSeries.single 0 ⟨_, haA⟩`. So the same proof works after deleting it.
